priority_items.title: FJI — G11 vote CLAIM for Constitution Amendment Bill; First Reading listed 30 Sep; HIV Bill fast-tracked same local day
priority_items.summary: Fiji Sun (20:00 UTC 29 Sep) reports G11 leader Naivalurua committing the 11-member bloc to Rabuka on the Constitution Bill. Paper coalition 38; two-thirds 36 or 37 pending Speaker ruling. Prasad says NFP may vote differently. First Reading listed 30 Sep FJT; Second Reading 2 Oct. Distinct FBC item (19:32:12Z): HIV-AIDS Amendment Bill 2026 harm-reduction clauses, vote listed 30 Sep FJT. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PIF/UNGA-81 close — PRF/sea-level diplomacy; West Papua OHCHR call; Tevi ICJ ask to France
priority_items.summary: UNGA-81 high-level week ended 29 Sep NZDT. Friday PIF–Guterres dialogue (Whipps/Waqa) pressed PRF capitalisation and maritime-zone permanence. Wale/Heine/Tevi renewed the Forum OHCHR-visit call on West Papua while Wale restated Indonesian sovereignty. Tevi (28 Sep) invited France to consent to ICJ jurisdiction on Umaenupne/Umaeneg (Matthew and Hunter). Heine warned on DSM. Teo cited Funafuti reclamation 15.3 ha. Not a recognition switch. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: SLB–CHN National Day reception; AUS–SLB treaty still unsigned
priority_items.summary: Island Sun 29 Sep: Acting PM Francis Sade and PRC Chargé Yang Jie at Heritage Park (28 Sep SBT). One-China restated; Yang CLAIM to elevate the comprehensive strategic partnership; police-training CLAIM; trade approaching US$4.3bn CLAIM; Auki Road handover November. Not a new security pact. AUS–SLB remains in-principle unsigned. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: SPDMM residual — SOFA negotiations tasked; PRG phased; PIF standing invite
priority_items.summary: FBC 29 Sep wrap of 22–24 Sep Nadi SPDMM (gap residual). Formal SOFA negotiations tasked to IWG; PRG HADR-first then possible stabilisation; Waqa Moana exploration; PIF Secretariat standing invitation; AUS hosts 2027. ABC 24 Sep: Hammond requires absolute consensus. Negotiations ≠ in-force SOFA. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: RBA lifts cash rate 25 bp to 4.60%
priority_items.summary: Tier A RBA MR-26-27 (29 Sep): unanimous increase to 4.60%, highest since 2011. Inflation, energy, AI-goods, domestic capacity. Further hikes if needed. Next decision 3 Nov leftover. AUD transmission into PIC imports/remittances/labour mobility. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: VUT — 27 Sep national mourning for 45 lives; Daily Post no longer leads 55/39
priority_items.summary: RNZ 28 Sep: Sunday memorial at Feiawa Park for Matui (11 Sep) plus Erromango–Tanna (7 Aug); 14 survived, 2 dead, 39 missing as reported. Daily Post /news LM 21:09:11 GMT listing no longer leads the 18 Sep 55/39 card. VBTC converted Tevi UNGA. Arrest unconfirmed. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: NRU — ICC withdrawal intent; US congratulations
priority_items.summary: Adeang told UNGA Naoero would deposit Rome-Statute withdrawal instruments. US A/S DeSombre congratulated DFM Kun (RNZ 28 Sep). Not a Taiwan/PRC switch. Confirm UN deposit. Not FLASH.
